question: What status and rarity are attributed to the Guhyakālī great mantra-knowledge?
premises: Guhyakālī is identified as a great mantra-knowledge
It is described as extremely difficult to obtain
Its rarity extends across the three worlds
inference: The Guhyakālī great mantra-knowledge is exceedingly rare in the three worlds.
plain_english: Guhyakālī is a great mantra, exceedingly difficult to obtain in the three worlds.
